subject: Expansion: onboarding three new squads + term/credit request
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@harvestlabs.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@harvestlabs.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion: onboarding three new squads + pricing question

Hi Soojin,

Quick note — we hit internal approval to expand Redwood across three additional squads (Search, QA automation, and Analytics). The teams will require separate API keys and fairly strict rate limits per team. Can you confirm:

- Rough monthly token estimate (we expect ~75M tokens across the three teams to start)
- Any seasonal burst/burst-protection we should consider
- Whether we can get a one-time onboarding credit and a 10% volume discount tier for the first 12 months while we ramp

We’re hoping to start pilot rollouts in early September. Priya (cc’d) will coordinate procurement if we proceed. I attached a short workbook with projected traffic by app.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Wu
Head of Product, Harvest Labs
alex.wu@harvestlabs.com

Attachment: HarvestLabs_expansion_scope_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@harvestlabs.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@harvestlabs.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: onboarding three new squads + pricing question

Alex — thanks for the clear breakdown and the workbook, that helps. High-level answers below; happy to schedule a 30m tomorrow to walk the numbers and a rollout plan.

- Tokens: 75M/mo maps to our mid-commit tier. I’ll pull exact unit economics for the Search vs Analytics profiles (different avg tokens per call).
- Bursts: we support burst capacity on Dedicated/Dedicated+ with configurable burst pools; hosted can handle short bursts but we recommend a reserve for predictable peak traffic.
- Credits/discount: I can propose a one-time onboarding credit (amount depends on committed term) and a temporary 10% volume discount for 12 months — will confirm with Ben on the commercials.

I’m looping in Ben Carter (cc) to align on pricing and any contract amendment. Also looping in Laura Bennett from CS to draft a staging/rollout runbook and propose API key segregation patterns.

If it helps, I can send a short amendment draft and a sample onboarding runbook by EOD Monday.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@harvestlabs.com>, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: onboarding three new squads + pricing question

Alex / Soojin — thanks for the context. We ran preliminary pricing against the workbook and here are commercial options to consider: 

Option A — Ramp commit (recommended):
- 12-month term amendment on current contract
- Commit: 75M tokens/month for first 3 months, then 100M tokens/month for remainder (tiered pricing)
- 10% volume discount for 12 months (applies to the committed tiers)
- One-time onboarding credit: $12,000 applied to first invoice

Option B — Flex (lower commit):
- Month-to-month increase with a 5% volume discount after 3 months if usage >60M tokens/mo
- Onboarding credit: $6,000

Notes: Dedicated burst pool add-on is available (+X/GB of burst capacity) and we can include per-key rate limits enforced in the gateway. For procurement, we’ll provide an amendment doc and a brief SOW for onboarding.

I’m happy to propose final numbers after a quick call with your infra/product folks (to nail token assumptions per endpoint). Laura, can you draft a 6-week rollout with checkpoints?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: harvest_amendment_draft.docx (Word, 14KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@harvestlabs.com>, Priya Singh <priya@harvestlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: onboarding three new squads + pricing question

Alex / Priya — draft rollout below (6 weeks) and a few operational asks. I attached the onboarding runbook with task owners.

Week 0 (prep): account config changes, create separate API key namespaces for Search / QA / Analytics, define rate-limit profiles
Week 1–2 (pilot): onboard Search team to a single pod, validate avg latencies and KV cache warm-up, run performance smoke tests
Week 3–4 (scale): add QA automation and Analytics, enable prefix caching and telemetry hooks, start ramping traffic to 20% of expected load per team
Week 5–6 (cutover): full traffic, observe SLOs, finalize alerts and cost dashboards; handover to Harvest's platform engineers

Operational asks:
- Provide contact for Harvest infra who will approve rate-limit settings
- Share sample inference workload traces (or lightweight replay) for pre-provisioning
- Confirm whether teams need separate billing namespaces or single consolidated bill

We can schedule a weekly 30m checkpoint during Weeks 1–6 and a post-mortem at Week 8. If the commercials land on Option A, we’ll include the onboarding runbook and a dedicated CS engineer (4 days) as part of the credit.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_onboarding_runbook_v3.pdf (PDF, 256KB)

Subject: Re: Expansion: onboarding three new squads + pricing question

Ben / Soojin / Laura — this looks good. Harvest prefers Option A; we’ll take the 12-month amendment with the 10% volume discount and the $12k onboarding credit. Priya and procurement will expect the amendment and the SOW so they can issue a PO.

Two quick notes before amendment: 
- Can you add explicit language that separate API keys will be issued per squad and that rate limits are enforced per-key?
- We’d like the onboarding credit as a line item on the first invoice for easier reconciliation.

Priya — looping you to confirm the PO timeline. If procurement signs off this week we can start the prep work next Monday.

Thanks all — excited to scale with the team.

Best,
Alex
Alex Wu
Head of Product, Harvest Labs
